t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They said that they don't think there is any pattern to the game, that it's all luck based.

vb_textbox.text: I think that there is a pattern in the game somewhere, I have tried many different techniques out and the one that seems to be the most rewarding is clicking the space bar as close to the end of the 1.5 seconds that you have with the basket. Every thing else seemed to be irrelevant, colours, how tall they all, how short they are, I think is best to ignore. I think what I noticed the most was the faster you click it, the less you get (Apart from on the green little mushroom men, for some reason faster was more rewarding). But apart from that just be patient and try hit it late, you may miss some, but the faster you go the less you get.
